headline: Approved issuing an RFP for Veteran's Pool construction and police purchases, including $87,324.00 in vests.
summary: The meeting covered road salt, guardrail costs, a Veteran's Pool construction RFP, and several police purchases. All items were approved unanimously. Police items included ammunition, shields, vests, computer workstations, and uniforms.
decisions: Approved the September 10, 2026 meeting minutes unanimously.
Approved Eastern Salt off of RI State MPA 125 as primary road salt vendor, with Morton Salt as backup, unanimously.
Approved a $25,000.00 increase to contract #26-009 with Reliable Fence for guardrails, paid from the Traffic Bond, unanimously.
Approved issuing an RFP for the construction phase at Veteran's Pool, unanimously.
Approved AAA Police Supply of Dedham, MA as the ammunition supplies awardee for $33,805.00, unanimously.
Approved $13,192.44 purchase of replacement ballistic shields from AAA Police Supply of Dedham, MA, unanimously.
Approved $87,324.00 purchase of replacement ballistic vests from Safariland, through DCF LE Supply, unanimously.
Approved purchase of seven Dell computer workstations from SHI International for $13,274.87, unanimously.
Approved Edward Deutch Uniforms of Providence as the awardee of police RFP #27-005, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: September 10, 2026 meeting minutes have been accepted. Lisa Bessette makes a motion to approve. Nancy Pelletier seconds. Unanimously approved

the department has selected Eastern Salt off of RI State MPA 125 as the primary road salt vendor for the upcoming winter... Christopher Brouillette makes a motion to approve. Lisa Bessette seconds. Unanimously approved.

the contract #26-009 with Reliable Fence of Woburn, MA for Installation of Guardrails along Main 7 Moshassuck Streets had to be adjusted upwards by $25,000.00, to be paid out of the Traffic Bond. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Nancy Pelletier seconds. Unanimously approved.
seeking approval to issue an RFP for the construction phase at Veteran's Pool. ... Lisa Bessette makes a motion to approve. Mark Wildenhain seconds. Unanimously approved

the awardee of the department's informal bid for ammunition supplies will be AAA Police Supply of Dedham, MA. The bid in the amount of $33,805.00 is budgeted through the ammunition/vest budget line item. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Nancy Pelletier seconds. Unanimously approved.

The low bidder of the department's informal bid for shields was AAA Police Supply of Dedham, MA. The shields cost $13,192.44 which is budgeted through the ammunition/vest budget line item. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Christopher Brouillette seconds. Unanimously approved.

Safariland, through distributor DCF LE Supply of Auburn, NH has been selected. The vests cost $87,324.00 which is budgeted through the ammunition/vest budget line item. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Lisa Bessette seconds. Unanimously approved.

seeking permission to purchase seven (7) Dell Computer Workstations from SHI International of Somerset, NJ, piggybacking their cooperative NASPO price agreement. Total cost of $13,274.87 is budgeted to the Computer Equipment line. Nancy Pelletier makes a motion to approve. Lisa Bessette seconds. Unanimously approved.

the awardee of the department's RFP #27-005 is Edward Deutch Uniforms of Providence All uniform costs are General Fund 100 items as budgeted. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Lisa Bessette seconds. Unanimously approved.
